# Sufoniq

> Sufoniq, operated by UAB Skillaxis, supports European employers with international candidate sourcing, screening and mobility coordination. It also provides job-search and relocation support for job seekers.

The canonical website is https://sufoniq.com. Insights explain data and systems; they do not guarantee jobs, visas, or outcomes. Consult the linked pages for current details and service boundaries.

## Services and company

- [Home](https://sufoniq.com/): Recruitment for hard-to-fill roles in Europe, connecting candidate sourcing and screening with preparation for a cross-border start.
- [For job seekers](https://sufoniq.com/work-in-europe): Service scope and practical support.
- [For employers](https://sufoniq.com/employers): Candidate sourcing and shortlisting against agreed role criteria, with interest and availability confirmed. Also covers preparation for cross-border starts and qualification requirements, with a direct hiring enquiry.
- [Truck driver recruitment](https://sufoniq.com/truck-driver-recruitment): Employer-focused international HGV recruitment, fleet-based screening and qualification planning. Candidate information is shared privately with consent.
- [Austria seasonal agricultural workers](https://sufoniq.com/austria-seasonal-workers): International sourcing and screening for Austrian agricultural employers, with seasonal preparation, employer responsibilities and a direct staffing enquiry.
- [About](https://sufoniq.com/about): Company background.
- [Method and trust](https://sufoniq.com/method-trust): Principles, constraints, and service boundaries.

## Research and context

- [Insights](https://sufoniq.com/insights): Editorial articles about growth, signals, and frameworks.
- [Growth](https://sufoniq.com/insights/growth): Visual exploration of growth and regional divergence.
